name: review
description: Senior ML reviewer assessment. Reads artifacts independently (reviewer independence protocol), scores 1-10, identifies weaknesses, specifies minimum fixes. Supports three difficulty levels: medium, hard (+ memory + debate), nightmare (+ repo access). Former ARIS: auto-review-loop Phase A.

artifacts.description: File paths for the reviewer to read independently. Only paths — no summaries or interpretations.

difficulty.description: How adversarial the reviewer should be

venue.description: Target venue for calibration (ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, ...)

weaknesses.description: Ranked list of weaknesses with minimum fixes
